summarization: This smartphone UI screen is promoting a feature that encourages users to try one lesson each day. It highlights that users will receive five lesson recommendations each week in the "Featured Lessons" section. The screen displays an illustration of stacked lesson cards and includes a prominent "Get Started" button at the bottom, inviting users to begin using the feature. The background is green, and the text is clear and concise, guiding users on what to expect from this feature.
